# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 4 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 35 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 16 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Zindex — 7 tokens; Opacity — 3 tokens; Linewidth — 8 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the paper theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-100, #f6f1e7);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dusk" or "contrast" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface-100, #161b1a);   /* the dusk theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f6f1e7;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | paper | dusk | contrast | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-100` | #f6f1e7 | #161b1a | #ffffff | Page and map-land ground. Text sits on this in body copy. |
| `--surface-200` | #fcfaf4 | #1f2625 | #ffffff | Raised panels, cards, sheets, dialogs and floating controls above the map. |
| `--surface-300` | #e9e2d2 | #101413 | #ededed | Sunken fields, hover wash, table header, skeleton blocks. |
| `--surface-inverse` | #22302f | #ece7da | #000000 | Tooltips and toasts. Text on it is on-inverse. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 56px/60px "Fraunces", "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-serif);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 56px / 60px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 400 | `serif` | Landing page title. One per page. |
| `display-lg` | `.display-lg`, `--text-display-lg` | 40px / 46px, letter-spacing -0.005em | 400 | `serif` | Panel title when a named river is selected on a large screen. |
| `heading-1` | `.heading-1`, `--text-heading-1` | 32px / 38px | 500 | `serif` | Page heading. |
| `heading-2` | `.heading-2`, `--text-heading-2` | 26px / 32px | 500 | `serif` | Section heading inside panels. |
| `heading-3` | `.heading-3`, `--text-heading-3` | 21px / 28px | 500 | `serif` | Card and dialog titles. |
| `heading-4` | `.heading-4`, `--text-heading-4` | 17px / 24px | 600 | `serif` | Small group headings. Sentence case. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `sans` | Introductions and empty states. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Default body copy and panel text. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Helper text, table cells, secondary panel text. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 14px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Form labels, button text, tab labels. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12.5px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Captions, attribution, map labels. |
| `coordinate` | `.coordinate`, `--text-coordinate` | 13px / 18px, letter-spacing 0.01em | 400 | `mono` | Coordinates beside sources and outlets. Tabular figures. |
| `measure` | `.measure`, `--text-measure` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `mono` | Distances, areas and elevations in tables and panels. |
| `figure-lg` | `.figure-lg`, `--text-figure-lg` | 34px / 38px | 400 | `serif` | Headline measurement in a panel. Set in the serif. |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (16)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Hairline gaps, icon to label. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Tight gaps inside controls and between chips. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Control padding, list row gaps. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Default padding for cards and panels. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Panel padding on desktop. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between sections inside a panel. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gap between panels and page sections. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Large section gaps. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Page margins on desktop. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Hero and empty-state breathing room. |
| `--space-24` | 96px | Landing page section spacing. |
| `--control-sm` | 36px | Compact controls inside dense panels. Not for touch-only surfaces. |
| `--control-md` | 44px | Default control height. Meets the 44px touch target. |
| `--control-lg` | 52px | Primary actions on mobile and the search field. |
| `--panel-width` | 360px | Width of the floating information panel on desktop. |
| `--sheet-peek` | 96px | Height of the bottom sheet when peeking above the map on mobile. |
